title: CS daily scratchpad - QBR prep + renewals
content:
Thu 2026-04-15 - Daily scratchpad

Top priorities for today:
- SageCloud QBR prep (10:30 AM PT call) bring usage trends, latency, top support issues, and cost-saving recommendations (Redwood Optimize suggestions). Deck pre-read: drive link above.
  - Action: finalize slide 4 (recommendations) with @Aisha by 9:30 AM.
  - Action: add 30/60/90 day success metrics (MAU, tokens/day, 95p latency).

- FinLedger renewal (EoM May) currently at 65% committed capacity. Renewal negotiation starting next week.
  - Reminder: pull last 3 months committed vs. actual usage (billing export).
  - Ask finance for potential discount tiers and renewal template (Jordan).
  - Note: FinLedger mentioned wanting on-prem evaluation; flag for Solutions Eng (possible private trial).

- Acme Retail support follow-ups:
  - Ticket CS-987 (embedding drift) engineering assigned (SRE backlog). Need ETA before QBR.
  - Ticket CS-1012 (rate limit spike) resolved but customer wants postmortem. Draft postmortem notes and circulate.

Meeting notes/agenda items (quick):
- 10:30 SageCloud QBR call run through: 1) wins since last QBR 2) usage + perf 3) open action items 4) roadmap alignment 5) recommendations (batching/quantization)
- 2:00 PM Sync w/ Jordan renewal strategy review (FinLedger + NovaHealth)
- 4:00 PM Check-in w/ Solutions Eng (possible on-prem evaluation gating items)

Quick todos (checked = done):
- [ ] Finalize SageCloud slide 4 (recommendations) @Aisha
- [ ] Pull FinLedger usage exports request from finance (Jordan)
- [ ] Draft postmortem for CS-1012 include incident timeline + mitigation
- [ ] Confirm SageCloud attendee list + dial-in -> send calendar invite update (include pre-read)
- [ ] Add QBR notes to Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-CSR-QBR-2026-04)

Notes to self / talking points for QBR:
- Emphasize cost wins from prefix caching and batching changes in March (show tokens saved).
- Call out one regression in latency on 4/02 (spike during nightly batch) explain mitigation and ongoing monitoring.
- Recommend pilot of quantized model for low-priority routing to save 15-20% on token cost (show Redwood Optimize rec).

Open questions / blockers:
- Need ETA from SRE on fix for embedding drift (impact on FinLedger search accuracy).
- Legal/Procurement: timeline for FinLedger PO? If >30 days, escalate renewal cadence.
- Who owns on-prem checklist for customer demo? cc: @Jordan / Solutions Eng.

Other notes / misc:
- Customer quote to use in QBR: "Model latency improvements reduced checkout friction" confirm exact wording with PM.
- Follow up with product about roadmap item: structured output support for invoices (SageCloud asked for example).

End-of-day quick wrap:
- Send meeting notes and action items to participants after SageCloud call.
- Update Confluence QBR page and mark action owners.
- Log time for QBR prep (billing/tag: cs_qbr_prep).
